# nomatron_organization (Data Source)

Fetch a single Nomatron organization by id or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nomatron_organization" "example" {
  name = "platform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Organization ID. If omitted, the provider can look up the organization by exact name.
- `name` (String) Exact organization name. If omitted, the provider reads the organization by id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the organization was created.
- `description` (String) Organization description.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata attached to the organization.
- `owner_user_id` (String) Owner user ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the organization was last updated.
